title: Building the Hotel Apartment Operating System

prompts.title: Department Dependency Mapper
prompts.when: Use after mapping departments and handoffs to identify dependencies and the accountable owner of each operating interface.

prompts.title: Move-In / Move-Out Checklist
prompts.when: Use before move-in or move-out to turn approved apartment requirements into a checklist with recorded evidence.

prompts.title: RACI Designer
prompts.when: Use when allocating responsibilities across the operating system; management must approve the proposed RACI.

prompts.title: Apartment Readiness Review
prompts.when: Use when inspection and defect records are available to prepare an apartment-readiness review; physical release stays with the authorized team.

prompts.title: Inspection Checklist Builder
prompts.when: Use when translating the approved guest-ready criteria into inspection checks and evidence requirements.

prompts.title: Room Audit Checklist
prompts.when: Use before auditing guest-ready performance to draft room checks against the approved property standard.

title: Preventive Maintenance Strategy for Hotel Apartments

prompts.title: Preventive Maintenance Planner
prompts.when: Use when planning preventive work from approved manufacturer requirements, asset criticality and verified maintenance history.

prompts.title: PM Interval Review
prompts.when: Use when reviewing whether a PM interval needs investigation; a competent engineer approves any interval change.

prompts.title: Metric Definition Checker
prompts.when: Use before reporting PM compliance to check metric definitions, denominators, exclusions and source records.

prompts.title: Cost of Poor Quality Analyzer
prompts.when: Use after collecting verified rework, failure and prevention costs to structure the cost-of-poor-quality analysis without double counting.

prompts.title: Department Cost Variance Analyzer
prompts.when: Use when an actual cost differs from budget and you need to separate supported causes from assumptions.

prompts.title: Variance and Trend Analyzer
prompts.when: Use when comparing quality-cost trends across periods with consistent definitions and verified source data.

prompts.title: Work Order Triage
prompts.when: Use when triaging an incoming work order against approved priority and escalation rules.

prompts.title: Maintenance Data Quality Audit
prompts.when: Use before analyzing the backlog to identify missing asset IDs, timestamps and closure evidence.

prompts.title: KPI Action Tracker
prompts.when: Use after a maintenance KPI breach to turn the verified exception into an owner, deadline and follow-up action.

prompts.title: Complaint Root-Cause Analyzer
prompts.when: Use once complaint facts and operating records are assembled to build hypotheses; verify the cause before approving corrective action.

prompts.title: Fishbone Facilitator
prompts.when: Use during a root-cause workshop to organize possible causes without treating the fishbone as proof.

prompts.title: Corrective Action Effectiveness Review
prompts.when: Use after corrective action to review whether evidence demonstrates effectiveness and prevents recurrence.

prompts.title: Asset History Summary
prompts.when: Use when consolidating an asset’s verified work orders, failures and inspections into a lifecycle history.

prompts.title: High-Risk Asset Prioritizer
prompts.when: Use when prioritizing assets for engineering review using approved criticality rules and current evidence.

prompts.title: Cost-Saving Business Case
prompts.when: Use when drafting a repair-or-replace business case from verified costs and explicitly stated assumptions.

prompts.title: Total Cost of Ownership Analyzer
prompts.when: Use when comparing purchase options across acquisition, operation, maintenance and end-of-life costs on a common basis.

prompts.title: Budget Assumption Checker
prompts.when: Use before approving the comparison to challenge unsupported budget assumptions and missing cost inputs.

prompts.title: Downtime Forecast Scenario
prompts.when: Use when testing the downtime component of a lifecycle scenario; keep forecast assumptions separate from observed losses.

prompts.title: SOP Structure Builder
prompts.when: Use after defining the operating scope to draft an SOP structure with roles, controls, exceptions and retained evidence.

prompts.title: Prompt Approval Workflow
prompts.when: Use when the SOP includes AI assistance to define who reviews and approves a prompt before operational use.

prompts.title: Process Compliance Review
prompts.when: Use when checking whether operating records demonstrate compliance with the approved SOP.

prompts.title: Service Recovery Options Draft
prompts.when: Use when comparing recovery options against the confirmed service failure and approved authority limits.

prompts.title: Cash Impact Prioritizer
prompts.when: Use when prioritizing verified failure costs by cash impact; confirm values with finance before making a decision.

prompts.title: Cost of Poor Quality Analyzer
prompts.when: Use to separate recurring service-failure costs from prevention and appraisal costs before setting improvement priorities.

prompts.title: Inspection Checklist Builder
prompts.when: Use to turn approved housekeeping standards into observable inspection criteria and evidence checks.

prompts.title: Work Instruction Builder
prompts.when: Use when a cleaning task needs a step-by-step work instruction with approved methods and limits.

prompts.title: Process Compliance Review
prompts.when: Use when testing whether actual housekeeping records and observations match the approved standard.

prompts.title: Reclean Root-Cause Analyzer
prompts.when: Use after recording reclean events to investigate recurring defects without guessing their causes.

prompts.title: Quality Trend Analyzer
prompts.when: Use when comparing inspection findings over time to identify supported quality trends and evidence gaps.

prompts.title: Control Plan Builder
prompts.when: Use after an improvement is agreed to draft the checks, owners and reactions needed to sustain it.

prompts.title: Workload vs Staffing Review
prompts.when: Use when comparing verified workload with available staffing while retaining service-quality and safety constraints.

prompts.title: Metric Definition Checker
prompts.when: Use before publishing productivity figures to confirm the unit of work, denominator and exclusions.

prompts.title: Housekeeping Productivity Review
prompts.when: Use when reviewing housekeeping output alongside room complexity, staffing and inspection results.

prompts.title: Corrective Action Effectiveness Review
prompts.when: Use after changing a process to check whether follow-up evidence shows fewer repeat defects.

prompts.title: Control Plan Builder
prompts.when: Use when defining acceptance checks and reaction rules that protect first-pass quality.

prompts.title: Checklist Generator
prompts.when: Use when converting approved completion criteria into a checklist; a completed checklist still requires the specified evidence.

prompts.title: Service Touchpoint Audit
prompts.when: Use when auditing service touchpoints against an agreed guest-experience standard.

prompts.title: Repeat Complaint Pattern Review
prompts.when: Use when reviewing repeat complaint themes alongside verified guest and operating records.

prompts.title: Quality Trend Analyzer
prompts.when: Use when combining audit findings into a trend review without losing source evidence or changing definitions.

prompts.title: Arrival Readiness Brief
prompts.when: Use before arrivals to compare reservations, room status and unresolved dependencies without promising unverified readiness.

prompts.title: Move-In / Move-Out Checklist
prompts.when: Use when controlling move-in and move-out handoffs with approved apartment checks and records.

prompts.title: Guest Journey Review
prompts.when: Use when reviewing the full journey for gaps between the promised service and the verified delivery.

prompts.title: Supplier Evaluation & Weighted Scoring Builder
prompts.when: Use when evaluating suppliers against agreed criteria and weights rather than price alone.

prompts.title: Evidence Gap Detector
prompts.when: Use before accepting a supplier assessment to identify missing inspection, compliance or performance evidence.

prompts.title: Cost-Saving Business Case
prompts.when: Use when proposing a procurement improvement and comparing verified savings with quality and continuity risks.

prompts.title: PAR Level Calculator Assistant
prompts.when: Use when setting PAR levels from verified consumption, replenishment time and approved service assumptions.

prompts.title: Purchase Requisition Quality Checker
prompts.when: Use before raising a purchase request to check specifications, quantities, need and approval information.

prompts.title: Department Cost Variance Analyzer
prompts.when: Use when stock costs differ from budget and a supported variance explanation is required.

prompts.title: Critical Spares Register Builder
prompts.when: Use when building a critical-spares register from approved asset criticality and verified spare-part details.

prompts.title: Critical Spare Parts Planner
prompts.when: Use when planning spare availability against current asset risks, lead times and approved maintenance requirements.

prompts.title: High-Risk Asset Prioritizer
prompts.when: Use when deciding which high-risk assets need further review before adjusting spare coverage.

prompts.title: Room Out-of-Service Risk Review
prompts.when: Use when reviewing an out-of-service room’s dependencies and risks before considering release.

prompts.title: Downtime Forecast Scenario
prompts.when: Use when comparing downtime scenarios from verified failure history; label forecasts and assumptions explicitly.

prompts.title: Cash Impact Prioritizer
prompts.when: Use when ranking confirmed downtime costs and cash impacts for management attention.

prompts.title: Daily Operations Briefing
prompts.when: Use before the daily briefing to combine verified priorities, dependencies and exceptions into a controlled operating picture.

prompts.title: GM Weekly Operating Review
prompts.when: Use at weekly review to challenge unresolved actions and recurring exceptions across departments.

prompts.title: KPI Action Tracker
prompts.when: Use after a KPI exception to document the accountable owner, next action and review checkpoint.

prompts.title: KPI Architecture Builder
prompts.when: Use after agreeing operating objectives to draft a balanced KPI hierarchy and source requirements.

prompts.title: Department Performance Challenge
prompts.when: Use when challenging department performance against verified measures and agreed accountability.

prompts.title: Control Tower Alert Logic Builder
prompts.when: Use once KPI definitions and escalation thresholds are approved to draft control-tower alert logic.

prompts.title: Early-Warning Indicator Designer
prompts.when: Use when proposing early-warning indicators from verified condition and failure evidence.

prompts.title: Metric Definition Checker
prompts.when: Use before scoring reliability to verify each input’s definition, denominator and source.

prompts.title: Apartment Reliability Heatmap Planner
prompts.when: Use when turning verified apartment risk and reliability data into a heatmap for human review.

prompts.title: Preventive Maintenance Planner
prompts.when: Use when checking that the reported PM programme reflects approved tasks, intervals and owners.

prompts.title: Maintenance Data Quality Audit
prompts.when: Use before calculating PM metrics to detect incomplete, inconsistent or unverified maintenance records.

prompts.title: Metric Definition Checker
prompts.when: Use when defining PM measures so planned, completed, overdue and excluded work are counted consistently.

title: The Hotel Apartment Operations Control Tower

prompts.title: Hotel Apartment Control Tower Daily Brief
prompts.when: Use when preparing the daily operating picture from verified departmental records and current exceptions.

prompts.title: Dashboard Requirement Designer
prompts.when: Use after agreeing management decisions to specify the dashboard views, sources and action requirements.

prompts.title: Decision Memo Builder
prompts.when: Use when an escalated exception needs a decision memo showing evidence, options and approving authority.

prompts.title: Strategic Priority Planner
prompts.when: Use after an evidence-based maturity assessment to draft improvement priorities for leadership review.

prompts.title: Control Tower Governance Checklist
prompts.when: Use when testing whether the proposed control tower has verified data, ownership and governed escalation.

prompts.title: Human Oversight Design
prompts.when: Use when assessing AI-supported maturity to define human checks, decision authority and oversight evidence.
